en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large, ornate early‑20th‑century building on a waterfront, seen from across a calm lake or river. In the foreground, two people sit in a narrow rowing boat on the water. Behind the tree‑lined embankment stands a substantial brick or stone public building with a steep hipped roof, dormer windows, and a small tower or cupola on top. Surrounding it are several bourgeois townhouses with mansard or steep roofs, and a promenade lined with trees runs along the shore. The style suggests a Central or Northern European city. No visible title or caption text appears on the image side.
